Multiple black mesh ergonomic task chairs are tucked around the desks. On the nearest desk surface, a glass of water and a wire mesh organizer holding files are visible. The overall palette is high-contrast monochromatic: white ceilings, white desks, black chairs, charcoal floor, with warm sand curtains providing the only soft warm note. The camera is at standing eye-level, roughly 5–6 feet, with a wide lens. The composition is a wide establishing three-quarter view looking diagonally across the desk rows toward the window wall.
